claims.limitation: Design is broader than executed atlas.

claims.limitation: Main run covers 6 high-priority axes on curated seed data.

claims.allowed_wording: Evaluated activation steering against prompt-only, random, and shuffled controls.

claims.limitation: Single boundary axis with synthetic artifact risk.

claims.forbidden_wording: QLoRA broadly dominates steering and prompt-only.

claims.allowed_wording: Batch 2 boundary adapter improved over Batch 1 pilot under sampled evidence.
